CertificateNumber.name: Certificate Number
CertificateNumber.definition: Unique identification or serial number that is assigned and affixed by an issuer or transfer agent to each securities certificate.

CertificatePrefix.name: Certificate Prefix
CertificatePrefix.definition: Prefix of a certificate which could differ based on where the issuance of certificates took place.

CertificateCalledAmount.name: Certificate Called Amount
CertificateCalledAmount.definition: Principal amount (for debt issues) or number of shares (for equity issues) that has been called for redemption for a particular certificate number.
